changelog: Auto-update now replaces the binary in-place on Linux/macOS (same as Windows)
listcoder run checks for updates in the background and notifies after the run
TUI re-checks for updates every 6 hours (not only at startup)
If the silent auto-upgrade fails, the user is still notified
listcoder upgrade --method <m> now forwarded to version resolution
install.sh honors VERSION env and normalizes the v-prefix
